propositions: Four graph functions have elevated cyclomatic complexity (18, 20, 16, 22 respectively) due to duplicated reduce-all-tickets-and-index loops and hand-rolled BFS traversal patterns
The identical reduce_all_tickets + drop error/fsck + index-by-id pattern is duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph, driving unnecessary branching
_get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level each re-implement a queue/visited BFS skeleton with per-node reduce and exception handling, creating a recurrent growth pattern
Refactoring onto two shared helpers (load_indexed_states and accumulator bfs) reduces CCN while preserving node-set, traversal results, and existing test behavior

The accumulator bfs must return only reachable nodes (excluding seed if unreachable, including blocks-targets with no backing dir) rather than visited set to preserve check_would_create_cycle membership semantics
